changes.replacement: Use InspectSignatures for inspection and ValidateSignatures / SignPackage / TrySignPackage for provider-backed package operations.
changes.reason: Package signature operations use the same stems; VBA and PDF external-signature workflows remain explicit.

changes.old: VisioPage.Width / Height / WidthCentimeters / HeightCentimeters / PageWidth / PageHeight
changes.replacement: Use OfficeLength.Inches, Centimeters, Millimeters or Points when setting dimensions, and ToInches/ToCentimeters when a numeric value is needed. OfficeLength rounds physical values to whole EMUs; native imported geometry and formulas retain their original numeric precision internally.
changes.reason: Physical dimensions have explicit units; the unit-specific and obsolete aliases are removed.

changes.old: VisioShape.PinX / PinY / Width / Height / LocPinX / LocPinY / GetBounds()
changes.reason: Shape bounds share the page dimension contract while native drawing scale and formulas remain Visio-specific.

changes.old: VisioDocument.AddPage(name, double width, double height, unit) / VisioPage.AddRectangle(double...) / SetMargins(double..., unit)
changes.new: AddPage(name, OfficeLength? width, OfficeLength? height, scaleUnit) / AddRectangle(OfficeLength...) / SetMargins(OfficeLength...)
changes.replacement: Wrap physical values in OfficeLength. Shape creation, constructors, page Size and margins use the same length contract; native formulas and source rendering remain numeric inches internally.
changes.reason: Public geometry uses OfficeLength. scaleUnit explicitly controls native drawing-scale metadata, never the interpretation of a physical length.

changes.replacement: Use the same physical arguments and defaults as VisioDocument, with an optional configure callback.
changes.reason: Adding a page, selecting an existing page and creating a missing page have separate names.

changes.old: VisioFluentPage.Rect / Square / Circle / Ellipse / Diamond / Process / Decision / Data / TextBox / Margins / Master / Title; VisioFluentShape.Style
changes.new: AddRectangle / AddSquare / AddCircle / AddEllipse / AddDiamond / AddProcess / AddDecision / AddData / AddTextBox / SetMargins / AddShape / AddTitle; ApplyStyle
changes.replacement: Use Add-prefixed primitive names and OfficeLength arguments. Native page and shape models own preparation and return the created shape; fluent wrappers return their scope. Fluent operations now use the model ID validation and exception contract, including InvalidOperationException for duplicate page-object IDs.
changes.reason: Fluent creation forwards to the same object-model methods, including explicit-ID overloads.

changes.old: VisioShapeBounds(double...) / numeric bounds properties; ResizeShape(..., width, height, unit); VisioShapeSelection.Size(double, double)
changes.new: VisioShapeBounds(OfficeLength...) / OfficeLength bounds; ResizeShape(..., OfficeLength, OfficeLength); Size(OfficeLength, OfficeLength)
changes.reason: Public physical bounds and size edits use explicit lengths. Native matrices, drawing scale and formulas retain numeric coordinates.
changes.replacement: Wrap each physical value in OfficeLength and convert explicitly when numeric native coordinates are needed.

changes.old: VisioFluentPage.Stencil / Connect / Shape / Container / Layer; VisioFluentConnector.Style
changes.new: AddStencilShape / AddConnector / GetShape / AddContainer / AddLayer; ApplyStyle
changes.reason: Fluent authoring forwards preparation and defaults to the corresponding model operation.
changes.replacement: Use the model argument order for stencils and connectors; configure callbacks remain optional fluent composition.

extraChanges.new: Visio page/document ToImage(options), SaveAsImage(pathOrStream, options), document SaveAsImages(folder, options) returning OfficeConversionReport
extraChanges.reason: Remove the fluent image surface while retaining format renderers, Core execution/persistence, streaming, deadlines, limits and diagnostic evidence.
extraChanges.qualification: Static preparation only. Parent applies and qualifies every maintained target; no build or test was run.
extraChanges.notes: The PowerShell cmdlet retains its current per-file PassThru shape using the same friend-only SaveImageResults pattern as Tier 1. Only its call site changes; aliases, loader, module foundations and M5 remain untouched.
